rationale.overall: The two takes are near-identical in geometry and palette, but B's smoother lower-right plane and slightly stronger tonal separation on the paper loop read marginally closer to the REFERENCE's continuous-tone lighting, so B edges it.
rationale.material: B keeps the light plane as a soft gradient the way the REFERENCE does, while A carries fine diagonal hatch streaks across it that read as pattern rather than lit surface; both takes are still far flatter than the REFERENCE, lacking its cast shadow, surface grain and translucent rim-light through the ribbon.
rationale.silhouette: Both takes share the same block angle, ribbon loop and plane-split composition with no discernible difference in outline or negative space.
rationale.smallsize: At 128, 32 and 16px the two strips are visually indistinguishable — both hold the dark bar plus orange underglow and both lose the ribbon loop to a grey smudge at 16px.
